She retrieves a pistol and katana and equips them. The majority of the film is Amy killing, dismembering, and decapitating zombies as they attack her. Amy kills the last zombie, leaving the house soaked in blood, then lets Will and Amber out of the basement.

VALIDATOR ISSUE:
The emphasized zombie-killing sequence is represented in only 3/8 beats; at least 5/8 beats must materially belong to it.

ALLOCATION PROCEDURE:

3. Every beat from Beat 4 through Beat 8 MUST materially perform the emphasized process.
4. Put the explicit final zombie kill plus the immediate child-release resolution in Beat 8 so Beat 8 still counts.
5. The plural/repeated zombie-killing process authorizes enough distinct ordinary zombie instances to fill Beats 4-8. Existing names in the rejected ARC are not a source-level cap. Never reuse a killed entity.
